youtube_title: Stomach Growling In A Silent Class? It's Not Just Hunger | Body Fix #13 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #13. Silent exam hall... and your stomach goes GRRR? Whole class heard it.
B is right. An empty gut runs a CLEANING WAVE.
Every ~90-120 min when empty, gut muscles sweep leftovers and gas along. That's the sound.
Fix: Small snack if hungry, sip water, don't skip breakfast, eat slowly.
Red flags: Pain, diarrhoea, vomiting or weight loss with it? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Cleveland Clinic - stomach growling (MMC)
